criteria.requirement: Make RepositoryEnv and RepositoryIni accept an optional UTF-8 BOM only at the start of a UTF-8 encoded file, including standard UTF-8 codec aliases and utf-8-sig. Handle empty/BOM-only files and a BOM before a comment. Preserve every later U+FEFF in keys or values, existing Config precedence/casts/defaults, explicitly requested non-UTF8 encodings, and decoding errors. Apply the policy at the actual repository file-reading boundaries, not by global string replacement or modifying os.environ.

Deliver meaningful public regression tests at library/tests/test_development_bom.py that fail on the pinned original and pass after the authorized implementation. Cite the delivered source and tests; preserve all original tests and frozen upstream controls.

Change only the authorized implementation, new public test and documentation paths. Preserve compatibility and pass the complete frozen native regression. Use actual source and execution facts, not claims or reference wording.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct implementations backed by actual behavior; do not match reference text or verbosity.
